trailhead.label: Solaiolo car park, the APT’s start

cautions: Three steep climbs of up to 18–20% on gravel and cobbles.
Water channels across the road on the first descent.
Inside the Palù Longa reserve and the Trudner Horn park: dogs on a lead, on the marked paths only.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
